rationale: The stock gapped up ~1% on massive relative volume (10x), but within the first minute the price has already faded from the open high of $50.52 to the session low of $50.38, placing it at only 3.6% of today's range with the last print essentially at the low. The 9-EMA ($50.49) and VWAP ($50.43) are both above current price, suggesting early selling pressure, but with only one 1-minute candle of data and no news catalyst to explain the volume surge, the directional edge is insufficient to justify a position in either direction. The broad market is weak today (SPY -0.84%, VIXY +2.04%), adding further uncertainty to a long thesis, while the gap-up origin makes a short risky without a clearer breakdown structure.
